product_metadata.title: Stack-Its 1 Inch Adjustable Bed Risers/Furniture Risers (Set of 8) Lifts Height 1", 2" or 3" – Black Heavy Duty Raisers
features: Stack-It adjustable risers add 1”, 2” or 3” height to furniture (2 sets required for adding 3") – great for adding height to desks, beds, tables, couches, sofas, dressers, and other heavy stationary furniture or objects
Each riser has a removable rubber gripper on bottom that protects floors from damage and stops furniture from sliding (Not recommended for use on high pile carpet)
To add height to furniture, simply stack these interlocking risers on top of each other. Each stack-it riser adds 1” height - max stack height is 3” (requires 2 sets)
Recessed holder top with universal fit contours designed to securely hold in all round furniture legs 1 to 3. 5 inches wide (1" - 3.25" square) and furniture panels / bases 0.5" to 1. 5 inches wide
Includes 8 black 1" tall x 4" round heavy duty bed risers with high weight capacity - Each individual stack-it riser will support up to 1, 000 pounds.
description: Raise your furniture to a more suitable height with Slipstick stack-it furniture risers. Designed to securely raise most types of furniture, these stackable risers add 1-inch incremental height to furniture and can be stacked together to add 2 inches (2 stacked risers) or 3 inches (3 stacked risers). Stacking stack-its together is easy, simply remove the rubber o ring from the bottom of one stack-it and stack it on top of another stack it and they will securely nest together. For safety reasons, it is recommended that no more than 3 stack-its be stacked together under each furniture leg - not recommended for use on high pile carpet. Each riser features a specially designed recessed holder top which holds all types of furniture legs that are between 1 inch to 3-1/2 inch (round) and 1 inch to 3-1/4 inch (square) in diameter at foot and furniture panels / bases with a width between 1/2 inch to 1-1/2”. Built strong to support even the heaviest furniture, each individual stack-it riser can support 1, 000 pounds. Perfect for raising low sitting furniture like desks, tables, couches, and sofas; these low profile risers are also great for creating extra storage space under beds and dressers. Safe on all floor surfaces, the removable rubber O-ring on the bottom of each riser protects floor surfaces from damage and provides a non-slip grip to keep supported furniture firmly in place. Includes 8 Black stack-it bed risers that are roughly 4 inches round by 1 inch tall. Covered by a 5-year free replacement and 1-year commercial.
